name: aidentity-mcp
description: Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for Aidentity to search skills, inspect security digests, and generate role blueprints.

tools.name: search_skills
tools.description: Search 534 verified AI agent skills by query, category, or tag.

tools.name: get_skill
tools.description: Retrieve complete metadata, provenance, and SKILL.md instructions for a skill by ID.

tools.name: verify_security
tools.description: Inspect 7-gate static security audit and SHA-256 digests for any skill.

tools.name: get_role_setup
tools.description: Retrieve deterministic workspace setup blueprint for any of 21 job roles.

tools.name: list_roles
tools.description: List all 21 available role blueprints with skill counts and profiles.
